extDescription.message: Use Duck.ai directly from Firefox to explain, translate, rewrite, analyze, research, debug code, and more.

commandOpenAssistant.message: Open Duck.ai assistant with current selection

myPromptsIntro.message: Create your own custom prompts. These appear in the "My Prompts" category in the action menu and context menu. Use them for any task not covered by the built-in actions.

myPromptsError.message: Please enter both name and instruction

myPromptsEmpty.message: No custom prompts yet. Add one above.

myPromptsEmptyMenu.message: No custom prompts yet. Add them in Settings → My Prompts.

supportTitle.message: Thank you for using Ask Duck.ai!

supportIntro.message: Ask Duck.ai is a free, open-source Firefox extension. If you find it useful, please consider supporting its development.

supportBmacDesc.message: If this extension saves you time, consider buying me a coffee. Every contribution helps keep the project alive and improving.

supportFeedbackDesc.message: Found a bug? Have a feature request? Your feedback helps make this extension better for everyone.

supportRateDesc.message: Help others discover Ask Duck.ai by rating it on Firefox Add-ons.

supportDocsDesc.message: Read the documentation to learn about all features and how to get the most out of the extension.

supportFooter.message: Ask Duck.ai is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by DuckDuckGo. "Duck.ai" is a trademark of its respective owner.

actionThink.message: What do you think of this?

duckAiIntro.message: The extension opens Duck.ai in a new tab and automatically fills in the chat with your prompt. You pick the AI model inside Duck.ai itself — no model list to maintain here.

optAutoSubmitHint.message: Automatically click "Send" after filling the prompt in Duck.ai. Turn off to review the prompt before sending.

popupSubtitle.message: Quick AI actions for any webpage

historyDisabled.message: History is disabled. Enable it in Settings.

customPromptsIntro.message: Customize the instruction sent to Duck.ai for each action. Leave a field empty to use the default instruction. Use {{input}} as a placeholder for the action's input (e.g. target language).

confirmResetAllPrompts.message: Reset ALL custom prompts to defaults?

optAutoSubmitHintUpdated.message: Automatically click Send after filling the prompt in Duck.ai. Turn off to review the prompt before sending (recommended — reduces bot detection).

optResponseLanguageHint.message: Choose the language for Duck.ai's responses. "Auto" lets Duck.ai decide based on the prompt.

optTextDirectionHint.message: Control the text direction of Duck.ai's responses. "Auto" detects based on the response language (RTL for Arabic, Persian, Hebrew, Urdu). Code blocks stay LTR.

optSmartDetectionHint.message: When enabled, the floating menu auto-detects the content type and reorders categories — Code Helper for code, Chef Helper for recipes, Research for articles, Grammar for paragraphs. All categories remain accessible.

optResetHint.message: Restore all settings to their default values. Custom prompts and user prompts are kept.

optFloatingButtonHint.message: Show a small Duck.ai button next to selected text.

optContextMenuHint.message: Add "Ask Duck.ai" to the right-click menu.

optDefaultActionHint.message: Used when invoking the assistant without picking an action.

optDefaultLanguageHint.message: Used when invoking Translate from a shortcut.

optDisplayModeHint.message: Show Duck.ai's response in a sidebar on the current page, or open Duck.ai in a full new tab.

optTestConnectionHint.message: Test that Duck.ai is reachable from this browser.

optUnofficialNote.message: Note: Duck.ai does not publish an official API. This extension opens Duck.ai's public web interface and fills in the chat input — exactly as you would do manually. See the About tab for details.

privacySummary.message: Your selected webpage text is sent only to Duck.ai. No telemetry, no analytics, no third parties. History stays on your device and is off by default.

privacyData1.message: Selected text: The text you highlight on a webpage. Sent to Duck.ai only when you trigger an action — never automatically, never to any other server.

privacyData2.message: Action choice: The action you pick (e.g. "Summarize"). Processed locally; becomes part of the prompt sent to Duck.ai.

privacyData3.message: Settings & prompts: Stored locally via browser.storage.local. Never uploaded.

privacyData4.message: History (optional): Off by default. When enabled, conversations are saved on your device only.

privacyData5.message: No credentials: The extension uses no API keys, tokens, or accounts. It opens Duck.ai's public website like a normal visitor.

privacyData6.message: Duck.ai's terms: Once your text reaches Duck.ai, it is governed by Duck.ai's Privacy & Terms. Review them to understand how DuckDuckGo handles your input.

permTabs.message: opens and focuses the Duck.ai tab.

permDownloads.message: saves backup files when exporting settings.

optHistoryEnabledHint.message: When enabled, conversations are saved on this device only. Nothing is uploaded.

optClearHistoryHint.message: Permanently delete all stored conversations on this device.

optClearAllHint.message: Remove settings, history, and all locally-stored data.

optExportHint.message: Download a JSON backup of all settings, custom prompts, and user prompts.

optImportHint.message: Restore from a JSON backup file. Choose whether to merge or replace existing data.

confirmImportReplace.message: This will REPLACE all existing data. Continue?

permActiveTab.message: accesses the current tab's selection when you invoke the assistant.

permScripting.message: injects the content script on pages where it hasn't loaded yet.

permClipboard.message: copies responses and code blocks to the clipboard.

shortcutsIntro.message: Firefox manages keyboard shortcuts at the browser level. To customize them:

shortcutsStep2.message: Click the gear icon, then "Manage Extension Shortcuts".

shortcutsStep3.message: Find "Ask Duck.ai" and edit the shortcuts.

shortcutOpenAssistant.message: Open Duck.ai assistant with current selection

aboutLead.message: Ask Duck.ai is a Firefox extension that lets you invoke Duck.ai on any selected webpage text — explain, translate, summarize, rewrite, analyze, research, debug code, and more.

aboutFeature1.message: Floating button: Appears next to selected text — click it to open the action menu.

aboutFeature2.message: Context menu: Right-click any selection to access all actions organized by category.

aboutFeature3.message: Toolbar popup: Click the toolbar icon to browse categories and run actions.

aboutFeature4.message: 70+ built-in actions: Common Questions, Quick Summary, Translate (12 languages), Grammar, Critical Thinking, Code, Learning, Work, Chef, Research, SEO, Security.

aboutFeature5.message: Custom prompts: Add your own prompts in Settings → My Prompts.

aboutFeature6.message: Page actions: Send or summarize an entire page without selecting text.

aboutFeature7.message: Keyboard shortcuts: Ctrl+Shift+D opens the assistant with the current selection.

aboutFeature8.message: RTL support: Force right-to-left text direction for Arabic, Persian, Hebrew, and Urdu responses.

aboutFeature9.message: Dark/Light theme: Matches your system or manual preference.

aboutDuckAi1.message: Duck.ai does not publish an official API for browser extensions. This extension uses the public website directly:

aboutDuckAi3.message: Builds a prompt from your selected text and chosen action.

aboutDuckAi5.message: Opens https://duck.ai/ in a tab (reuses an existing one if open).

aboutDuckAi6.message: A content script fills the chat input with your prompt and optionally clicks Send.

aboutDuckAi8.message: If automatic injection fails, the prompt is copied to the clipboard so you can paste it manually.

aboutDisclaimer1.message: Not affiliated with DuckDuckGo. This is an independent, open-source extension. "Duck.ai" and "DuckDuckGo" and their logo are trademarks of DuckDuckGo, LLC — used here only to describe what the extension interoperates with.

aboutDisclaimer2.message: How it works: The extension opens Duck.ai's public website and fills the chat input with your prompt — exactly as if you typed it yourself. It does not call any private API, use credentials, or bypass Duck.ai's terms. Once submitted, your input is governed by Duck.ai's Privacy & Terms.

aboutDisclaimer3.message: Your responsibility: AI can make mistakes and answers may be inaccurate — please double-check the answer. Do not send sensitive, confidential, or personal information. The authors are not liable for any damages arising from the use of this extension.

confirmClearAll.message: Remove ALL extension data? This cannot be undone.

errorDefaultMessage.message: An unexpected error occurred. Please try again.

errorNetworkMessage.message: Could not reach Duck.ai. Check your internet connection and try again.

errorHttpMessage.message: Duck.ai returned an error. Please try again in a moment.

errorNoTokenTitle.message: Could not start a Duck.ai session

errorNoTokenMessage.message: Duck.ai did not provide a session token. The service may be temporarily unavailable.

errorUnauthorizedMessage.message: Your Duck.ai session expired. Please retry; a fresh session will be created automatically.

errorRateLimitMessage.message: Duck.ai is rate limiting requests. Please wait a few minutes and try again.

errorTimeoutMessage.message: Duck.ai took too long to respond. Try again, or increase the timeout in Settings.

errorEmptyMessage.message: Duck.ai returned an empty response. Try rephrasing or picking a different action.

errorStreamMessage.message: The response stream was interrupted. Please try again.

errorEmptySelectionMessage.message: Select some text on the page first, then choose an action.

errorNoHistoryMessage.message: There is no previous response to regenerate.

errorStateMessage.message: The conversation state is inconsistent. Start a new conversation and try again.
